We say that the the Lorentzian distance future distinguishes events (the spacetime is future d -distinguishing) if d p = d q ⇒ p = q , and that is past distinguishes events if d p = d q ⇒ p = q . The spacetime is d -distinguishing if it is both future and past d -distinguishing, namely: d p = d q or d p = d q ⇒ p = q . We say that the spacetime is weakly d -distinguishing if d p = d q and d p = d q ⇒ p = q .
